limitations: Development source and same build-host binaries, not a released wheel.
Branin and a correlated quadratic valley are public optimization benchmarks, not engineering CAE acceptance.
Inference includes ask and suggestions, including host estimator/candidate construction and recording; it is not pure kernel timing.
Only 16 CPU threads are measured here; previous thread sweep remains separate evidence.
Two sessions per configuration; process initialization affects total inference, and history windows expose warmed behavior.
Batch objectives execute serially; this measures proposal reuse, not objective parallelism.
Transfer bytes and retained workspace capacity are measured; isolated transfer time and whole-process peak memory are not.
No Python/DB, Rustuna, GP/BoTorch or general Optuna API compatibility claim.
